instruments.evidence_quote:
As of December 31, 1999, the Company has zero-cost financial contracts
("collars") in place that hedged a total of 1,000 barrels of oil per day
("MMcf/d") through July 2000 and 500 barrels of oil per day through November
2000.

instruments.notes: Second set of zero-cost collars. Start date not stated (in place as of Dec 31, 1999).
instruments.evidence_quote:
The first set of contracts had a weighted average ceiling price of
approximately $20.65 per barrel and the second set of contracts had a ceiling
price of $25.85 per barrel. These contracts had a floor price of $18.50 and
$21.00 per barrel, respectively.

hedging_summary.stated_hedging_policy: Sells ~60% of natural gas under long-term fixed price contracts and swap agreements; hedges oil/gas with price ceilings and floors, no-cost collars and fixed price swaps. Also has interest rate swaps (ignored).
